newRegions.name: Bangladesh (national)
newRegions.notes: Single national region. The file lists 30 AEZs (BARC 1989) but gives no per-AEZ fertilizer or sowing-window data; all doses and windows are national-level. Used only where the schema requires a region (planting windows); recommendations stay country-wide (regionSlug null).

recommendations.applicationTiming: Urea split in two: 67% at 15 DAT, 33% 5-7 days before panicle initiation
recommendations.micronutrients: S3 Zn1 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BRRI recommended nutrient doses; sources: urea, TSP, MoP, gypsum, zinc sulphate. Via Bangladesh J. Agril. Res. 41(4), 2016.

recommendations.applicationTiming: Urea split in two: 67% at 15 DAT, 33% 5-7 days before panicle initiation
recommendations.micronutrients: S4 Zn2 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BRRI recommended nutrient doses; sources: urea, TSP, MoP, gypsum, zinc sulphate. Via Bangladesh J. Agril. Res. 41(4), 2016.

recommendations.micronutrients: S8 B1 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARC FRG-2018-era value for T. Aman from field study (distinct from the BRRI table above); keep as separate record. Via MDPI 2021.

recommendations.micronutrients: S6 Zn3 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BRRI nutrient doses via Bangladesh J. Agril. Res. 41(4), 2016. BARC FRG product-rate equivalent for Boro (BRRI dhan29, haor): urea 300, TSP 112, MoP 127, gypsum 75, ZnSO4 11 kg/ha -> converts to N 138 (300x0.46), P2O5 51.5 (112x0.46), K2O 76.2 (127x0.60) kg/ha; gypsum/ZnSO4 left as products (S/Zn conversion not done).

recommendations.applicationTiming: 2/3 N basal, 1/3 at 21 DAS after irrigation
recommendations.micronutrients: S20 Zn4 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARI-era recommended dose (BARI Gom-24). BARI (2010) product rates: TSP 180, MoP 50, gypsum 120 kg/ha. FRG 2005 soil-test-based ranges exist but not reproduced here. FRG 2018 confirmed single figure NOT FOUND verbatim.

recommendations.applicationTiming: All except urea basal; urea in 3 splits
recommendations.micronutrients: S15 Zn2 B1 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARC FRG (2018-era) dose; sources: urea, TSP, MoP, gypsum, zinc sulphate, boric acid. FRG 2005 soil-test ranges reduced 30% for kharif. Via MDPI 2021.

recommendations.micronutrients: S40 Zn6 B2 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: FRG 2012-era high-yield dose for sole hybrid maize (distinct record from the 2018-era FRG dose). Another FRG-2012 citation: N 250, P 76, K 121, S 72, Zn 5, B 1.

recommendations.applicationTiming: Half N basal, rest at 35 DAP
recommendations.micronutrients: S10 Mg5 Zn2 B0.5 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: FRG 2012 dose + cowdung 5 t/ha. Variant FRG-2012-era RF (Bhola raised-bed trial): N 115, P 30 (truncated in source excerpt). Via Bangladesh J. Agri. 2023.

recommendations.micronutrients: S19 Zn4 B1.7 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARI TCRC recommendation used in trials + cowdung 6 t/ha (distinct record from FRG 2012 dose).

recommendations.applicationTiming: N split: half before sowing, half 45 days after germination
recommendations.micronutrients: gypsum 45, zinc sulphate 11 kg/ha as reported products (apply only where soils are S/Zn deficient)
recommendations.notes: BJRI variety-wise fibre recommendation (all white & tossa varieties). Product rates urea 100, TSP 25, MoP 45 -> N 46.0 (100x0.46), P2O5 11.5 (25x0.46), K2O 27.0 (45x0.60) kg/ha. Exception: Falguni tossa (O-9897) urea 200 kg/ha (~92 N). BARC 2005 RDF (urea 200 + TSP 50 + MoP 60 + gypsum 100) cited as older alternative.
recommendations.soilContext: Gypsum & ZnSO4 only where soils are S/Zn deficient

recommendations.micronutrients: gypsum 40, ZnSO4 4 kg/ha as reported products
recommendations.notes: BJRI seed-production rates (tossa). Products urea 80, TSP 40, MoP 16 -> N 36.8 (80x0.46), P2O5 18.4 (40x0.46), K2O 9.6 (16x0.60) kg/ha.

recommendations.micronutrients: gypsum 18, ZnSO4 4 kg/ha as reported products
recommendations.notes: BJRI seed-production rates (deshi/white). Products urea 70, TSP 20, MoP 12 -> N 32.2 (70x0.46), P2O5 9.2 (20x0.46), K2O 7.2 (12x0.60) kg/ha.

recommendations.micronutrients: S15 Mg1.5 Zn1 B1 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARC FRG 2018 recommended (BARI Sarisha-14). Via BJAR 47(4), 2022.

recommendations.micronutrients: gypsum 120, zinc oxide 2 kg/ha as reported products
recommendations.notes: BINA 2008 product rates converted: urea 180 -> N 82.8 (180x0.46), TSP 140 -> P2O5 64.4 (140x0.46), MoP 100 -> K2O 60.0 (100x0.60) kg/ha. Trial dose (AEZ-11, BARI Sarisha-14): N 120, P 35, K 65, S 20, B 1.5 + Zn 2-4 + 5 t cowdung/ha.
BJAR sowing-time study (urea, TSP, MoP). Product variants reported: urea 45, TSP 85, MoP 35 kg/ha (BARI Chola-5/9 study); urea 45, TSP 120, MoP 70, gypsum 90 kg/ha (genotype study).

recommendations.micronutrients: S13 Zn2 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARI Bt Begun-2 soil-applied dose. Via BJAR 49(2), 2024. FRG 2005 has soil-test-based brinjal ranges (not reproduced here).

recommendations.micronutrients: S12 Zn2 B1 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: FRG-2012-based dose + cowdung 10 t/ha. K dose not stated in source excerpt (recorded as null, not invented). Variant: N 250, P 80, K 125 kg/ha + cowdung 5 t/ha (coastal trial). Via BJAR K study.

recommendations.micronutrients: S19.6 B1.3 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: Soil-test-based dose (BARI Joydebpur) + cowdung 5 t/ha. BARI Peaj-1 study cites a 'recommended dose (150-100-180 kg/ha ...)' but the excerpt is truncated; treated as partial, not recorded.

recommendations.micronutrients: S22 Zn3 B2 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: BARI recommended (Spices Research Centre, Annual Research Report 2023-24) + cowdung 5 t/ha.

recommendations.micronutrients: S9.5 Zn0.2 B0.9 (kg/ha elemental as reported)
recommendations.notes: Soil-test-based alternative (BARI Joydebpur); distinct record from the BARI recommended dose. Via Bangladesh Agronomy Journal (baj-85857).

recommendations.micronutrients: S15 Zn2 B1 kg/ha
recommendations.notes: BARC FRG 2005 dose (via BJAR)
BJAR 2022 improved pattern (Atia, Tangail trial) — kept separate from FRG 2005, not averaged

recommendations.micronutrients: S20 Zn0 B1 kg/ha as reported
recommendations.notes: BJAR 2022 improved pattern (Atia, Tangail trial)

refused.reason: Official BARC FRG lentil NPK dose NOT FOUND in ws4. Only a per-acre trial conversion exists (Gopalganj 2019: urea 45, TSP 90, MoP 45, gypsum 55, ZnSO4 3 per acre ~ urea 111, TSP 222, MoP 111, gypsum 136, ZnSO4 7.4 per ha) — a trial suggestion, not an official recommendation, so no record created.

File states the FRG 2018 confirmed single wheat figure was NOT FOUND verbatim. The 2024 BARI Gom-32 study dose (N 140, P 25, K 110, S 16) is a trial citation, not the official FRG figure, so only the BARI-era dose (N 120, P 35, K 50, S 20, Zn 4) is recorded.
refused.what: Wheat FRG 2018 confirmed single NPK figure

windows.notes: Aus season; short, rainfed, pre-monsoon. Sown (not transplanted).
Aman season (mostly T. Aman); transplanted. Main monsoon, largely rainfed.
windows.verificationNote: Verified 2026-10-06: activityType corrected SOW→TRANSPLANT per research. Months 6-7 confirmed.

windows.notes: Boro season; nursery Nov-Dec, transplanting Dec-Jan. Fully irrigated dry-season crop.
Rabi; mid-Nov to mid-Dec typical (trials sown 14 Nov-4 Dec).
Rabi (main season); optimal Nov-Dec (trials tested 5 Nov-5 Jan).
Rabi planting; 90-95-day crop duration. Planting trials 31 Oct-5 Dec.
Fibre crop sowing: deshi/white late Feb-Apr, tossa 15 Mar-Apr. 100-120 days field duration.
Seed production (off-season); mid-Jul to last week of Aug.
Rabi; early-mid Nov optimal (relay broadcast ~late Nov before T. Aman harvest; trials 2 Nov-21 Nov).
Rabi (Masur); mid-Nov sowing (trials 10 Nov-12 Dec); ~110-120 days. Windows OK per file; NPK refused.
Rabi (Chola); late Oct-late Nov (trials 2 Nov, 22 Nov-1 Jan, 25 Nov); ~120 days.
Rabi (BAMIS Dhaka calendar, 190-210 days): seedbed Oct, transplanting Nov.
Rabi (BAMIS Dhaka calendar, 120-150 days): seedbed Sep-Oct, transplanting Oct-Dec.
windows.verificationNote: Verified 2026-10-06: window trimmed 9-12→9-10 (BAMIS bounds seedbed to Sep-Oct; Oct-Dec is transplanting).

windows.notes: Rabi (BAMIS Dhaka calendar, 100-110 days); BARI Piaz-1 trials transplant 1 Nov-1 Dec.
Rabi/winter (100-120 days): seedbed 2nd week Oct, transplanting late Nov-Dec.
